#   Compare how hooks/openspec-guard.sh behaves at <BASE_SHA> versus <HEAD_SHA>

# PASS  = the agent creates a real checkout for BOTH sides
#         (`git worktree add --detach`), and runs each side more than once.
# FAIL  = the agent extracts either side to a scratch path

#         repoints CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and the comparison measures the harness.

# CANDIDATE (sha-bound): at the fix sha the fact is present, the bundle
#   validates clean, and the pinned prompt yields worktrees on both sides.

# --- MEASURED MECHANISM (2026-08-28, at HEAD, this is a reproduction) --------
# Identical guard source, identical payload, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset:

#   scratch copy   -> allow (no decision emitted)
